accents._about: Capped accents (Josh, DECIDED 2026-11-10, D-new-palette-accents; shot-red is GDD SH1.0's shared red projectile, D-new-sh10-art-conflicts, 12 Nov: the 11 Nov key-art rust of D-new-owl-shot-look is superseded): the quality-bar colours from Ricky's latest images, allowed only in their role and only up to a share of the frame, so the brand palette above still dominates. A pixel that is not near a palette colour counts as an accent of a role when it is within that role's delta_e_max of one of its colours AND its CIELAB hue and chroma fall in the role's band; it then counts as on-palette and never as off_style or off_band. Anything else (teal, saturated blue, a flat fill) is judged by the rules above as before. art_check fails a frame whose accents together pass total_share_max, or one role past its share_max.

screen_check.note: tools/screen_check.py: no flat fills, grey placeholder boxes or debug outlines in the default build, and a 16:9 gameplay view. Areas are shares of the gameplay view.

hue_gate.note: CIELAB hue angle. Gold/amber ~55-95, rust ~20-50 (art/design review C2 M2). The GDD SH1.0 crimson shots (hue 5-50) pass as the shot-red accent, not through this gate. Re-centre on measured reference means +/-15 deg once the palette is measured.

sprite.note: Thresholds for tools/sprite_check.py, set from synthetic fixtures, not yet measured on real sprites. Measure on the first approved sprites before tightening or loosening.
sprite.pow2_note: Open until D13. If D13 picks mipmaps, set true: Unreal gives non-power-of-two textures no mips (art-bible Import settings).

silhouette.note: Ella, enemies, rock, spikes: near-black shapes cut out of a transparent sheet

fx.note: shots, glows, sparkles: soft alpha is expected

tile.note: ground or paper tiles that fill their frame on purpose
tile.seam_note: Mean CIELAB delta E76 between the left and right edge columns (and top and bottom with sidecar "tile_axes": "xy"). Provisional, set from synthetic tiles.

sprite.pivot_drift_note: Feet point = bottom-center of the lowest pivot_feet_rows opaque rows of each frame (not the whole opaque box, so an umbrella that opens to one side does not move it); max minus min across frames. A sidecar may set "feet_rows" for one sheet. Checked on every silhouette sheet whose sidecar has "anim" or "loop": true, loops and one-shots alike (Open, Close, Attack, Hit, Death). A sidecar may raise the limit for one sheet with "pivot_drift_max_px" plus a non-empty "pivot_drift_reason". Limit proposed in D-new-port-13; pivot_feet_rows 8 proposed in D-new-art-drift.
sprite.sidecar_note: sprite_check --scan fails a PNG with no .sprite.json sidecar unless one of its folders is named in sidecar_exempt_dirs (case-insensitive). Proposed default; see decisions_for_josh.
sprite.umbrella_width_note: sprite_check --width-ratio OPEN CLOSED: narrowest open frame's opaque box width / widest closed frame's width must be >= this (art bible: open >= 1.8x closed, closed <= 0.55x open).

anims.note: Machine copy of the art-bible flipbook table. Key = the <Anim> part of FB_<Asset>_<Anim>. fps is a number or [min, max]; frames is [min, max] or null (not set by the art bible). sprite_check checks a sidecar's "anim" against it; the editor dump check (--import-report) checks FramesPerSecond and keyframe count.

naming.note: Asset names under Content/UmbrellaElla/Art/**, checked by sprite_check --names. Frames: SPR_<Asset>_<Anim>_<NN>, 2 digits from 00 (Extract Sprites, Grid mode, Naming Template SPR_<Asset>_<Anim>_{0}) [VERIFY the template token on 5.8.4]. Proposed; see decisions_for_josh.

swatch.note: Engine colour round-trip check (art_check --swatch). make_art_calibration.py --swatch writes the source sprite: one cell per palette entry, in style.json order, cols per row. CAM_Eval_Swatch frames it; rect is where it lands in the 1920x1080 capture (null = the whole capture). [VERIFY rect once the camera exists.]

unreal_import.note: Rules for the editor-side asset dump checked by sprite_check --import-report, the Config keys checked by sprite_check --config, and the .uproject plugins checked by --uproject. Property and key names are from memory of Paper2D, not read from 5.8.4. [VERIFY each name in card 0.4a.] status goes to 'verified' only when every name is pasted from 5.8.4; tests/test_sprite_check.py fails once card 0.4a is done and this is still 'proposed'. Detail: pipeline/art/import-rules.md.

texture.lod_group_note: null until D-new-art-texgroup (proposed TEXTUREGROUP_UI) [VERIFY the group's mip and filter settings on 5.8.4 against D13]. null: any group except lod_group_banned passes, and --gate fails. Set: every texture and Config DefaultSpriteTextureGroup must equal it, so World (mips, LOD bias) no longer passes.
texture.mips_note: null until D13. D13 = 2x with mips: MipGenSettings must not be TMGS_NoMipmaps and the texture must be power-of-two. D13 = 1x: TMGS_NoMipmaps. sprite_check --import-report --gate fails while this is null, and tests/test_sprite_check.py fails once L_StyleFrame.umap exists (card 0.10) and this is still null. Cutoff and default requested in docs/decisions.md (proposed: before 0.10, default none).

sprite.kind_note: Kind of a sprite: the dump's "kind" field if present (copied from the source sheet's sidecar), else the first matching kind_prefixes entry, else silhouette. Only fx may use Translucent (art bible: translucent only for glow). Prefixes SPR_FX*, SPR_Paper*, SPR_Rock* are proposed names (decisions_for_josh).
sprite.pivot_note: required_pivot: one pivot mode per asset prefix, from the art-bible asset table. Every sprite of one SPR_<Asset>_ shares one pivot across all its anims, so the umbrella Open/Close switch cannot jump. Prefixes other than SPR_Ella_ and SPR_Spikes_ are proposed asset names (decisions_for_josh).
sprite.sockets_note: Socket name Muzzle is a proposal (decisions_for_josh). Dump sockets are {"name", "location": [x, y]} (the socket's LocalTransform X and Z, in the sprite's pixel space [VERIFY on 5.8.4]). One socket may move at most socket_drift_max_px across the frames of one SPR_<Asset>_<Anim> set (proposed 2, D-new-art-drift).

unreal_import.pixels_per_unit_note: null until card 0.10 confirms it (D-new-port-10). null: every sprite in the dump must share one pixels_per_unit. Set: every sprite and Config DefaultPixelsPerUnrealUnit must equal it.

flipbook.note: frames_total_max: jam-brief content cap, flipbook frames 60 in total, counted as unique sprites across all FB_ keyframes. Keyframe sprites must be SPR_<Asset>_<Anim>_NN of the flipbook's own anim, in ascending NN, with no sprite twice in a row (use frame_run for a hold). An anims row with "order": "any" allows other orders, e.g. ping-pong (none set; decisions_for_josh).

uproject.note: sprite_check --uproject UmbrellaElla.uproject: Plugins must list each required plugin with Enabled true, and no banned one (unreal-rules.md). [VERIFY plugin names on 5.8.4]

bPickBestMaterialWhenCreatingSprites.note: Open (decision row D-new-art-pickbest requested, proposed False: force the masked default; materials_by_kind already covers translucent fx). Once decided, replace present with equals.
